audit_name: Day 22 Checkpoint 027 131Ce Signature and Polarimetry Design Audit

verdict.phonon_signature_rule: A 1-phonon wobbling excitation carries wobbling phonon quantum number n_w = 1 and signature alpha_w = 1; thus, for an odd-A nucleus with yrast signature alpha_0 = -1/2, the n_w = 1 band MUST have signature alpha_1 = alpha_0 + 1 = +1/2
verdict.selection_rule_implication: All transitions from n_w = 1 to n_w = 0 must change signature by Delta-alpha = 1, restricting interband transitions to odd spin differences: Delta-I = 1, 3, ... (M1, E2, E3). Transitions with Delta-I = 2 connect states of identical signature (Delta-alpha = 0) and are strictly forbidden for 1-phonon wobbling
verdict.experimental_observation: Alwaleedi 2013 Table 4.2 / Fig. 4.1 establishes 3 clean Delta-I = 2 E2 transitions (871.2, 994.3, 1108.0 keV) directly connecting Band 4 to Band 1
verdict.mathematical_falsification: The presence of prominent Delta-I = 2 E2 interband transitions directly rules out Band 4 as a 1-phonon wobbling excitation of Band 1, independent of any mixing ratio measurement
verdict.physical_interpretation: Band 4 is either a signature-coupled multi-quasiparticle structure or a gamma-vibrational excitation (Delta-K = 2, Delta-alpha = 0) built on the triaxial/gamma-soft core

polarimetry_design.specification: A Compton polarimeter measurement achieving sigma_P <= 0.15 will separate the small root from the large root at > 4 sigma statistical confidence, providing an unequivocal resolution of the multipolarity
